messages:
adele (SRE): starting a thread to collect artifacts for the post-incident writeup for the high-5xx spike this morning on hosted inference. incident id INC-19924. root cause unknown yet — we mitigated by routing traffic to fallback-model-pool and restoring KV cache. creating timeline & assigning owners here.

incident-bot: INC-19924 | High rate of 5xx on inference-hosts.prod | first alert 2026-03-14T14:07:11Z | severity: P1 | paging: @morgan (primary) -> @sanjay (secondary) | auto-fallback engaged.

morgan (oncall): quick notes from pager: around 14:07 we saw 5xx burst across 3 AZs, tail latency spiked. I started mitigation at ~14:10 by invoking the routing fallback (flow documented in runbook). patched a hotfix to the autoscaler at 14:18 to stop aggressive scale-down. handed off at 14:35 to @sanjay for infra deep-dive.

sanjay (infra): got the handoff. initial hypothesis: a KV cache eviction storm + a mempool limit on the inference runtime caused retries and downstream 5xx. I pulled kernel logs and the jvm heap-sized logs for the controller. attaching snippet below.

sanjay (infra): ```
Mar 14 14:09:56 infer-host-3 kernel: OOM kill invoked, cache-worker pid=4821
Mar 14 14:10:01 infer-host-3 service[redwood-runtime]: ERR failed to allocate kv entry: capacity exceeded
Mar 14 14:12:03 infer-host-2 runtime[pid=1287]: WARN continuous-batcher timeout after 2000ms
```

elaine (PM): customer impact summary from support: 12 customers reported 5xx errors; highest impact was AcmeCorp (enterprise) between 14:08-14:26; they reported degraded throughput for batch inference jobs (non real-time) — CS rep @tara filed a support ticket and has been in touch. No contractual SLA breach expected but we should include the exact request/response counts in the writeup.

adele (SRE): action items I propose (please reply with owner/ETA):
- [ ] Collect ingress and egress request counts per customer (14:00-15:00) — owner: @morgan? ETA EOD
- [ ] Upload full controller and runtime logs to evidence bucket + preserve node disk images — owner: @sanjay ETA tomorrow morning
- [ ] Reproduce cache-eviction locally and test increased kv cache size across model shards — owner: infra/bench team (sanjay) ETA 2d
- [ ] Draft impact summary for customers and proposed comms (AcmeCorp) — owner: @elaine ETA today 17:00 UTC
- [ ] Update runbook with explicit autoscaler thresholds that triggered cascade — owner: runbook-maintainers (I'll take initial PR) ETA 3d

morgan (oncall): I'll grab the request counts and add the pager timeline to the doc. quick curl to fetch aggregated metrics:
```bash
curl -sS "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=sum%20by(customer)(increase(requests_total%5B1h%5D))%20%20%7Bservice=~\"redwood-inference.*\"%7D" > /tmp/INC-19924-reqs.json
```

ops-bot: Evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-postmortem/INC-19924/ (retention 90d) — logs, traces, and core dumps upload pending.

elaine (PM): scheduling: can we do a 45-min postmortem review tomorrow 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC? Need at least infra, SRE, product, and support reps. If that works I'll book a meeting and invite legal for customer comm check.

adele (SRE): that slot works for me. @morgan @sanjay please confirm. Also we should have a short pre-read (timeline + customer impact) posted 6h before.

morgan (oncall): works. I'll post raw timeline + pager notes to the evidence bucket tonight.

sanjay (infra): works for me. I'll upload logs and a short repro playbook.

adele (SRE): RCA drafting plan:
- Phase 1: factual timeline & evidence (owner: @morgan)
- Phase 2: infra analysis and contributing factors (owner: @sanjay)
- Phase 3: customer impact + comms draft (owner: @elaine)
- Phase 4: proposed remediations & owners (owners assigned during review)
- Phase 5: peer review & sign-off (requires at least 2 reviewers from SRE/Infra/Product)

elaine (PM): I'm volunteering to be a reviewer and will focus on customer-facing wording. @ashley (legal) — can you be on standby for review after the meeting?

morgan (oncall): note on evidence: traces show a sharp rise in retry loops originating in continuous-batcher which correlated with KV misses. attaching a short trace id: trace-0x9a7f (uploaded to bucket).

sanjay (infra): preliminary contributing factors list (draft):
- KV cache size misconfiguration for newly onboarded model shard 7
- Autoscaler scale-down threshold too aggressive under short-lived memory pressure
- Runtime held on to partial state while background GC ran (caused temporary connection errors)

adele (SRE): please add any other potential contributing factors to this thread. we'll consolidate into the 'Contributing factors' section of the writeup.

elaine (PM): on comms for AcmeCorp: recommend templated explanation + offer for post-incident call. I'll draft and post here for review before legal signs off.

morgan (oncall): one more ops detail: fallback routing reduced error rate by ~80% within 6m of activation. screenshots of the dashboard KPIs uploaded to the bucket under /dashshots/.

ops-bot: Reminder: add the exact request/response counts to the evidence doc. Use tag "metrics-verified" when finished.

adele (SRE): assign reviewers for peer review stage — please react with :eyes: to claim reviewer role. Need 2.

sanjay (infra): :eyes: happy to review infra section.

elaine (PM): :eyes: will review customer-impact & comms wording.

morgan (oncall): final note: I'm keeping the incident timeline short and factual — will include timestamps for each mitigation step and the handoff notes (14:35 Handoff to @sanjay). I'll ping when the pre-read is uploaded.

adele (SRE): thanks everyone. after the review we'll add the remediation tickets to the sprint and set owners. current open ticket placeholders: INFRA-2345 (increase kv capacity + monitoring), SRE-6789 (autoscaler tuning & runbook update), PG-1122 (customer comms + post-incident meeting).

elaine (PM): adding a request: please include estimated cost/regressions for any remediation that touches autoscaler or runtime defaults. I'll need that for prioritization.

morgan (oncall): noted. I'll add a rough cost estimate for toggling autoscaler thresholds based on recent EC2/gpu pricing.

adele (SRE): closing notes: this thread will serve as the authoritative collection point for evidence and owners until the writeup is published. if you add artifacts to the bucket, post a brief one-line note here with the path.

sanjay (infra): uploaded /logs/INC-19924/controller.log.gz and /images/INC-19924-node-3.tar.gz to s3 path from ops-bot.

morgan (oncall): uploaded /metrics/INC-19924-reqs.json and /traces/trace-0x9a7f.json. tagged metrics-verified.

ops-bot: Postmortem meeting created: 2026-03-15T16:00:00Z — calendar invite sent to participants.

adele (SRE): perfect. everyone, please add any missing evidence by EOD today so the pre-read can be shared. We'll aim to have a completed draft for peer review within 48 hours of the meeting. Thanks all.
